annotations.text:
Home · the single launch surface.
Motion: strips crossfade in with an 8 px rise (220 ms, 40 ms stagger). PLAY press: the button fills as a progress track while the launch steps tick, then the window snaps toward the tray icon in 500 ms; reverse when the session ends. Pointer light rides the strip top edges.
Content kept from today's Home; the profile chips move here from Play.

Play · the session page (was the launch page).
Motion: each step's check draws in over 160 ms as the phase completes; the elapsed timer runs in mono; live tiles crossfade digits in place (120 ms). Terminate is hold-to-confirm: 600 ms, fills red, release early cancels. Ambient field is in its warmer 'session' state.

Performance · Windows tweaks and profiles.
Motion: a row expands in 180 ms with the chevron rotating; toggling shows a 240 ms gold sweep along the leading edge. Requirement badges (Admin, Restart, Moderate) replace the old bracket tags. Nothing else moves.
Cut for your yes/no: the separate 'What each setting does' section is folded into the row disclosures.

Settings · two-column strips.
Motion: static page; the Save bar appears with a 160 ms rise only when a value changed, and settles after saving.
Added for your yes/no: an Appearance > Motion checkbox 'follow the Windows animation setting' (on by default), because your Windows has animations off. Theme segment shows Dark / Chrome / System (Chrome = the deferred light mode).

System sheet · the spec Phase 3 builds from.
Tokens, the glass recipe as shader inputs, every control in every state, floating glass and the tray menu, and the motion table. One open renderer item: the shader masks a rounded rectangle today; the HUD chamfer needs a chamfer distance field (small change, Phase 3).

A · Obsidian · motion: slow.
Ambient gold drifts on a ~12 s cycle. Pointer light rides the slab rims. PLAY press: the slab thickens (blur 40 to 56, rim brightens), steps reveal, then the window sinks toward the tray over 700 ms.
Tradeoff: heaviest blur = highest GPU cost; darkest ground leaves the least contrast headroom for muted text.

B · Prism · motion: lively.
Drift on a ~8 s cycle with two colored bodies passing each other. Chroma fringes shift with pointer angle (the aberration follows the light). PLAY press: the sheet lifts 4 px and the fringes flare, then the window folds to the tray.
Tradeoff: the most color on screen and the easiest to overdo; thin glass shows ambient noise through text, so every text block needs its scrim.

C · HUD · motion: fast, mechanical. CHOSEN 2026-09-02.
Strips slide in from the rail side with a 160 ms stagger. PLAY press: the capsule fills as a progress track while steps tick in the strip; window snaps to the tray in 500 ms.
Tradeoff: density reads as tool, not premium; angular geometry fights the round refraction the shader does best.

Phase 1 directions, kept for the record.
Three Home screens, same content and palette; what differed: glass thickness, type, geometry, chroma intensity, tempo. The strip shows the same eight components in all three treatments. C was chosen; the hi-fi screens are on the first page.
